info.title: HCL Domino REST API DXL Extension APIs
info.description:
Experimental : Full-featured database design management: 
database properties, per-element CRUD

get.description: Returns database title, replica ID, file path, template info, and launch settings

put.description: Updates database launch settings (open to frameset, page, etc.) and title

get.summary: Get a full design inventory of the database
get.description: Returns every design element in the database grouped by type. Each element includes its name, aliases, UNID, and note ID. No DXL is returned, keeping the response lightweight.

404.description: Help document not found in database

get.summary: Get the About or Using document as DXL
get.description: Exports the database's About (NoteID 0xFFFF0002) or Using (NoteID 0xFFFF0100) help document as DXL. These are special notes present in every NSF.

put.summary: Create or replace the About or Using document
put.description: Imports DXL to create or replace the database's About or Using help document. The DXL body should be a <helpaboutdocument> or <helpusingdocument> element (as produced by the GET endpoint). The imported note is signed with the current user's identity.

404.description: Help document not found in database

delete.summary: Delete the About or Using document
delete.description: Permanently removes the database's About or Using help document. The database will behave as though no help document was ever set.

404.description: Icon note not found in database

get.summary: Get the database icon note as DXL
get.description: Exports the database icon note (NoteID 0xFFFF0010, DocumentClass.ICON) as DXL. This is the special note that controls the workspace icon — distinct from the $DBIcon image resource.

put.summary: Create or replace the database icon note
put.description: Imports DXL to create or replace the database icon note. The DXL body should be an <iconnote> element (as produced by the GET endpoint). The imported note is signed with the current user's identity. Launch settings are automatically preserved across the replacement.

404.description: Icon note not found in database

delete.description: Permanently removes the database icon note. The database will revert to the default Domino icon on the workspace.

get.description: Returns name, UNID, note ID, and $Flags for every element of the given type. The flags field is omitted when empty.
Returns the frameset structure as an orientation/sizes/content tree

put.summary: Create or replace a frameset from JSON layout
put.description: Converts the JSON layout to DXL and imports it. Creates the frameset if it does not exist.

get.summary: Get outline entry tree as JSON
get.description: Returns the outline's entry hierarchy as a label/target/children tree. Supports both flat level-based and nested DXL formats, including imageref properties.

put.summary: Create or replace an outline from JSON entries
put.description: Converts the JSON entry tree to flat DXL with level attributes for hierarchy and imports it. Supports nested children arrays and optional imageref per entry. Creates the outline if it does not exist.

200.description: Validation result — valid flag, errors array, warnings array, and raw log

post.description: Two-pass validation: XML well-formedness check, then a dry-run importer pass with all options set to IGNORE so nothing is written to the database. Returns errors and warnings from the importer log.

200.description: Job accepted — contains jobId and initial status

post.description: Accepts a DXL string and starts an import in the background. Returns a jobId immediately. Poll `GET /import/{jobId}` for status.

get.description: Returns the current status of an async DXL import job. Status is one of: pending, running, complete, error.

200.description: ACL entries array and roles array

get.description: Returns all ACL entries and the list of roles defined in the database

400.description: Invalid level, unknown roles, or missing fields

put.summary: Create or update an ACL entry
put.description: Creates the named ACL entry if it does not exist, or replaces it with the supplied level, roles, type, and flags

delete.description: Removes the named entry from the ACL. -Default- and LocalDomainServers are protected and cannot be removed.

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: Set to true for a full database export (includes ACL, properties, and all design elements)

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of design element types to export (e.g. form,view,frameset)

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Set to 'properties' to include database properties DXL alongside filtered type export

400.description: Neither full nor types parameter supplied

get.description: Exports design elements as a DXL `<database>` document. Defaults to a full database export when no parameters are supplied. Use `types=form,view,...` for a filtered export by element type. Combine `types` with `include=properties` to also return database properties DXL.

get.summary: Export a single design element as DXL
get.description: Returns the design element's DXL in a JSON wrapper

put.summary: Import a design element from DXL
put.description: Creates or replaces the named design element from a raw DXL body. The imported element is automatically signed with the current user's identity, so agents and script libraries are immediately runnable.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the named design element from the database

type.description: Entry type — PERSON, GROUP, or SERVER

roles.description: Roles assigned to this entry (must already exist in the ACL)

dxl.description: Full DXL string to import (must include <database> wrapper)

designOption.description: How to handle existing design elements

documentsOption.description: How to handle documents in the DXL

replaceDbProperties.description: Whether to update database-level properties from the DXL

name.description: Frameset name (may be omitted — taken from path param)
Outline name (may be omitted — taken from path param)

frame.description: Target frame name for links opened from this entry

expanded.description: Whether this entry is expanded by default

imageref.description: Image resource name displayed next to this entry (e.g. 'view.png')

name.description: Design element name (all kinds except url)

children.description: Nested outline entries — same structure as parent entries

whenOpened.description: What to open when the database is opened in Notes

target.description: Page name, view name, or URL depending on whenOpened

nsfPath.name: nsfPath
nsfPath.description: Relative path to the NSF file on the Domino server

type.name: type
type.description: Design element type: form, subform, view, folder, frameset, page, agent, scriptlibrary, sharedfield, sharedcolumn, navigator, outline, imageresource, fileresource

aclEntryName.name: aclEntryName
aclEntryName.description: ACL entry name (e.g. CN=User/O=Org, -Default-, a group name)
